name: SlideGrid
summary: SlideGrid is a modern sliding puzzle game that blends classic gameplay with rewarding progression and customization. Solve beautifully crafted image puzzles across 4×4, 6×6, and 8×8 difficulty modes, earn coins for every completed puzzle, and spend them strategically to lock correctly placed pieces for extra assistance. Browse a gallery of built-in images, upload your own photos to create custom puzzles, unlock completion badges, and enjoy a clean interface with light, dark, and ambient color themes. Whether you're looking for a relaxing brain teaser or a more challenging puzzle experience, SlideGrid offers smooth gameplay, persistent progress, and endless replayability.
